## Activity

During May 2023, River Outreach completed 55 captures. Activity proceeded in line with the planned outreach schedule. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. The available information indicates that the site maintained its scheduled activity during the month, with no operational issue recorded beyond that routine staffing variation.

## Image quality

Of the 55 captures completed, 5 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 9.1%. The result should be monitored through routine review of image acquisition and capture processes. Continued attention to capture technique and image quality may help reduce the number of ungradable examinations in subsequent reporting periods.

## Grading

A total of 6 results were referable. The median grading lag was 0. This indicates that the reported grading workflow operated without a median delay during the month. Activity, image quality and grading outcomes should continue to be reviewed together in routine site monitoring, so that any change in ungradable or referable results can be identified promptly and considered alongside operational arrangements at River Outreach.
